reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
summary: The one line that set the input to an empty string on Escape is removed; Escape still closes the list. This is the default the maintainer proposes in #485.
caveats: The clear event is still emitted on Escape although nothing is cleared any more; listeners for it may now be misleading.
#485 also proposes a clearOnEscape option for the old behaviour; an upstream pull request would need to add it.
